{{Top|leg}}
'''CoreWorld Capital''' was a supposed investing firm that employed [[Droid/Legends|droid]] investors during the [[third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The firm marketed itself as "five-star" and said that they would earn their clients "big money."<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=message|CoreWorld Capital Wants You!|ERROR: Code J23-O9-N557-A59-S12}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Got big dreams of telling your boss to shove off? Message us now to learn how you can earn big money, all From our expert Droid investors! Good money fast from our five-star investing Information. Talk is cheap, but Soon you'll be able to buy a lot of it!|ERROR: Code J23-O9-N557-A59-S12|<ref name="TOR" />}}
CoreWorld Capital was mentioned in the [[2019]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by the company [[BioWare]]. In the Imperial Saboteur storyline, where the player secretly works with the Galactic Republic, the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] receives a message from the supposed firm, which can be decrypted as "Got Message From Droid Good Information Talk Soon" when only reading the words beginning with capital letters.<ref name="TOR" />
